Kajsa Rinaldo Persson (born 11 November 1997) is a Swedish tennis player. Rinaldo Persson has a career-high singles ranking of 288 by the Women's Tennis Association (WTA), achieved on 28 October 2024, and a career-high WTA doubles ranking of 532, reached on 21 August 2023. She has won five titles in singles and four in doubles on the ITF Circuit . Rinaldo Persson has represented Sweden in the Fed Cup , where she has a win–loss record of 10–10, as of April 2024.
